body:
I hope you’ll come – and spread the word about – this gathering in Dallas this November. It’s not too late to register –

 https://www.facebook.com/pg/PerkinsTheologySMU/events/

  

  

  

 Christianity’s global impact is grounded in the worship and work of local congregations. Sandra Maria Van Opstal and Brian McLaren will teach us how to create world-changing, transformational worship. Register for JustWorship today! https://www.smu.edu/Perkins/PublicPrograms/Perkins-Fall-Convocation/JustWorship2018

 Posted by Perkins School of Theology, Southern Methodist University on Thursday, October 4, 2018
